item.title: Dual-cation solvation-tailored electrolyte solutions for low-temperature 48-V/30-Ah lithium-ion battery modules
item.description:

Nature Nanotechnology | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in a dual-cation, core–shell solvation structure—a 2Li⁺–TEP inner core with a loose DFOB⁻/carbonate outer shell—that decouples Li⁺ solvation from desolvation. This overcomes the conductivity/desolvation trade-off, enabling stable operation down to −50 °C across coin cells and 48-V/30-Ah modules with diverse chemistries, marking a significant step toward practical low-temperature lithium-ion batteries.

💡 This work pioneers minimal-component electrolytes for −60°C high-energy Li-ion cells pairing nickel-rich cathodes with silicon-containing anodes—previously unaddressed. item.title: From Localized Mn Defect to Oxygen Loss: The Interplay of Jahn–Teller and Pseudo–Jahn–Teller Distortions
item.description:

Journal of the American Chemical Society | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in identifying localized Pseudo–Jahn–Teller distortion, driven by Mn vacancies and crystal water, as the dominant degradation mechanism in Na-birnessite—outweighing cooperative Jahn–Teller effects. Significance: suppressing Mn vacancies breaks electronic-vibrational coupling, mitigating oxygen loss and enabling 1000-cycle stability, shifting design focus from macro-JT suppression to local-PJT mitigation for durable sodium-ion cathodes.
